title: Icons in God's House! ⛪ A Church Tour for Kids | Bible Lesson for Kids | Sunday School
desc:
Welcome to God's house! ⛪✨ In this Sunday School lesson for kids, Mina and Marina take a tour of the church with Mommy, Daddy and Abouna. They learn what icons are, why we can paint Jesus, where Jesus and Saint Mary stand on the iconostasis, meet Saint Mina and Saint George, find out why an egg hangs in church, and learn that a candle is a little prayer.

📖 Memory verse: "For where two or three are gathered together in My name, I am there in the midst of them." (Matthew 18:20)
🎯 Lesson: Be respectful and prayerful in God's house. Walk quietly, speak softly and face the altar, because Jesus is there with us.
🙏 Great for Sunday School, Kindergarten and family devotion time.
